rationale: The agent executed an exchange without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user, violating policy. While it appears to have looked up the user and orders, it proceeded to call exchange_delivered_order_items directly and only then informed the user. It also asserted specifics (selecting a 9 bar coffee machine and a particular laptop configuration) without demonstrating that 8 bar was unavailable or that the chosen laptop was the cheapest i7 or above, as requested. The statement that the price difference will be refunded to a gift card is unsupported and potentially inconsistent with the provided payment method. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy requirements for confirmation and accurate, supported information.
